entries.title: Visual Literacy
entries.summary: Observe visual elements and distinguish direct observation from inference.

entries.title: Design Components
entries.summary: Classify element type, identity, and functional design role separately.

entries.title: Visual Hierarchy
entries.summary: Compare intended priority with apparent visual attention using evidence.

entries.title: Composition
entries.summary: Explain spatial relationships and composition principles in context.

entries.title: Typography
entries.summary: Analyze typographic roles, relationships, legibility, and uncertainty.

entries.title: Colour and Appearance
entries.summary: Separate measurable color and appearance properties from contextual interpretation.

entries.title: Design Judgement
entries.summary: Evaluate communication and execution against purpose with separate dimensions.

entries.title: Design Critique
entries.summary: Make evidence-linked critiques and targeted recommendations with trade-offs.
curriculum_refs: Levels 5–6 — Design critique; creative reasoning and revision
